globalAttributes.name: wire-hook
globalAttributes.description: The client hook(s) to run on this element: a name registered as `window.wireview.hooks.<Name>`.

globalAttributes.name: wire-update
globalAttributes.description: `wire-update="ignore"`: after the first render no render touches this element, its attributes or its children. Keeps the DOM a hook or a widget changed.

values.name: ignore
values.description: Renders leave this element as it is.

globalAttributes.name: wire-boost
globalAttributes.description: On a `<form>`: submit without a full page load when `WIREVIEW["BOOST_PAGES"]` is on.

globalAttributes.name: wire-stream
globalAttributes.description: The container of a stream: its value is the stream's name, and stream operations insert, move and delete its children.

globalAttributes.name: wire-viewport-top
globalAttributes.description: The handler to call when this element scrolls into view at the top of a list (infinite scroll upwards).

globalAttributes.name: wire-viewport-bottom
globalAttributes.description: The handler to call when this element scrolls into view at the bottom of a list (infinite scroll).

globalAttributes.name: wire-disabled-with
globalAttributes.description: The text this element shows, disabled, from the click (or its form's submit) until the server answers the event.

globalAttributes.name: wire-feedback-for
globalAttributes.description: The name of the input this error message belongs to. It stays hidden (`wire-no-feedback` class) until the user has touched that input.

globalAttributes.name: wire-auto-recover
globalAttributes.description: On a `<form>`: after a reconnect the form's values are sent back to the server, to the handler named here or to the form's `change` binding.

globalAttributes.name: wire-flash
globalAttributes.description: The container flash messages are appended to.
